title: QVP Qualification Guidance
description: Clarify the qualification-verification request behind your Saudi employment process.
answer: Qualification verification and a practical trade examination are different processes. Begin with the profession, employer request and the current official programme instructions.

sections.title: Who this helps
sections.text: Applicants whose employer or processing authority has asked for qualification verification for Saudi employment. Do not assume a requirement applies to every profession or every visa.

sections.title: What we can help with
sections.text: We help you distinguish the named programme, assemble preparation questions and compare the requested qualification with your records.

sections.title: Keep control of the application
sections.text: The competent programme determines eligibility, evidence and results. Any action that requires the applicant’s identity, consent or account must follow the official rules; we do not bypass those rules.

sections.title: What varies
sections.text: The occupation, qualification, work experience and requesting organisation affect the questions to ask. Confirm the current instructions before paying any third party.

steps: Identify the profession and employer request
Distinguish verification from a trade test
Prepare evidence for the official route
